result:
All findings are verified. Here are the answers.

---

**h01** — Component: the **S3 presign runner** (`*s3presign.Runner`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), whose `CheckAndPresign` re-signs S3 object URLs that are within 4 days of expiry (`runner.go:47`, threshold at `runner.go:88`). Schedule: **every 12 hours** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`, ticker loop `runner.go:29`), plus one eager run at boot. Wiring: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` constructs it and calls `RunOnce(ctx)` then launches `Run` in a goroutine — `server/server.go:162-170`, itself invoked from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02** — Delivery function: **`webhook.Post`**, executing the outbound POST at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152` (`safeClient.Do(req)`); handlers actually enqueue via `webhook.PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`) drained by 4 worker goroutines. Protection: an SSRF guard wired into the HTTP transport, **`safeDialContext`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`), which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`); plus write-time validation **`webhook.ValidateURL`** (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`). Both are disabled by the `--allow-private-webhooks` flag (`AllowPrivateIPs`, `validate.go:41`).

**h03** — Abstraction package: **`internal/idp`** (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, `internal/idp/idp.go`). Concrete implementation: **`internal/idp/oauth2`** (OAuth2, `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`). OAuth2 is the only protocol implementation that ships.

**h04** — **No.** Outside the `NewDBDriver` factory (`store/db/db.go:22`), `mysql.NewDB` is never called. The `store/db/mysql` package is imported only by `store/db/db.go:8`, and the only other direct construction of `mysql.DB` is a `&DB{}` literal in `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12` (test code).

**h05** — Mechanism: **explicit Go code**, inside the `DeleteUser` transaction, not a DB cascade. Reactions are removed two ways: by memo content-id (`deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx`, e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380`) and by creator (`deleteReactionsByCreatorTx`, `sqlite/user_delete.go:400`), both called from `deleteUserTargetsTx` (`sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102`); mirrored in the postgres and mysql drivers (`.../user_delete.go:102`). Evidence it is *not* a DB rule: the `reaction` table (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92`, original `.../0.20/00__reaction.sql`) has no foreign key or `ON DELETE CASCADE` on `creator_id`/`content_id`.

**h06** — Handlers (all in `server/router/api/v1/`): **`CreateMemo`** (`memo_service.go:70`), **`UpdateMemo`** (`memo_service.go:401`), **`DeleteMemo`** (`memo_service.go:518`), plus `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`) and `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`). Convergence: all paths funnel through **`webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` → `:120`); at the API level 5 of the 6 converge in **`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`).

**h07** — Request `GET /file/users/{username}/avatar`:
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (route registered `fileserver.go:124`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` → `driver.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136-137`
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (reads `avatar_url`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (peers `postgres/user.go:87`, `mysql/user.go:84`)

**h08** — Two declarers, both named `Runner`: `*memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) and `*s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`).
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — **invoked** — caller `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`); also self-called from `Run` (`s3presign/runner.go:36`).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — **not invoked** — dead code (its `NewRunner` constructor has zero callers).

**h09** — **6 distinct `Close` declarations** in backend non-test code: `*v1.SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `*cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `*mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `*postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `*sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `*store.Store` (`store/store.go:72`). (proto/gen has none.) Invoked by non-test server code:
- `*store.Store.Close` — caller `Server.Shutdown`, `server/server.go:146`
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — caller `Store.Close`, `store/store.go:74-76`
- `*v1.SSEHub.Close` — caller `closeLongLivedConnections`, `server/server.go:206`
- `*sqlite/postgres/mysql.DB.Close` — reached only indirectly via the `Driver.Close()` interface call in `Store.Close`, `store/store.go:78` (no direct concrete caller).

**h10** — **`util.GenUUID`** — `internal/util/util.go:40` — approx **7** distinct non-test callers (28 including tests). It ties `filter.DefaultEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go:111`, 7 non-test) on production count and wins once tests are included.

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (~7 packages outside the store tree: `server/router/api/v1`, `.../rss`, `.../fileserver`, `server/auth`, `.../frontend`, `server/notification`, plus the v1 test pkg). 2nd: **`store.Memo`** (~6 packages, ~4 non-test).

**h12** — Concrete method: **`(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo`** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (the `INSERT INTO memo` built at `:17-27`). Determination: the driver is selected in the `NewDBDriver` factory switch (`store/db/db.go:14-26`) on `profile.Driver`, whose default is `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122,130`); `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`, so the sqlite implementation runs with no DB flags.

**h13** — Interface: **`markdown.Service`** (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`). Impl: the unexported **`service`** struct wrapping goldmark (`markdown.go:58`), the only runtime implementation. Construction: **`markdown.NewService`** called once in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`), reached from `server.NewServer` (`server/server.go:76`). Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`v1.go:35`), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (injected at `server/server.go:85`; field `rss.go:45`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`runner.go:16`, not constructed at runtime). MCP does **not** hold it.

**h14** — Computation site: **`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`** (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`), delegating to `(*service).ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` only on the `content` field-mask branch (`memo_service.go:447`); the batch `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`runner.go:52`) also would, but is unwired. Extracted properties written to `MemoPayload`: **`Tags`** (`runner.go:85`), and `Property` fields **`Title`** (H1), **`HasLink`**, **`HasCode`**, **`HasTaskList`**, **`HasIncompleteTasks`** (`markdown.go:387-403`). (`Mentions` are extracted but not persisted; `Location` is set from the request, not derived.)

**h15** — Distinct visibility-enforcement surfaces:
- gRPC single-memo read gate `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39` (used by `GetMemo` `:356`)
- gRPC `ListMemos` query-level restriction — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- Comments: `ListMemoComments`/`CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148-161`, `:41`
- Attachment access (gRPC) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-452`; `ListMemoAttachments` `memo_attachment_service.go:214-226`
- Reactions — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-40`, `:83`
- SSE live fan-out `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-142`
- RSS: `GetExploreRSS`/`GetUserRSS` (hardcoded PUBLIC) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90`, `:141`
- Fileserver attachment gate `checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650`
- Notifications `canViewerAccessMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302` and (duplicated) `server/notification/email.go:306`

**r01** — False premise: there is **no Redis**. The cache layer is an in-process, in-memory `cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go`). Store creates three caches (instance-settings, users, user-settings) with a **DefaultTTL of 10 minutes** (`store/store.go:41`, `store/cache/cache.go:59`), 5-minute cleanup, max 1000 items. So the "user entries" TTL is 10 minutes, via the in-memory cache — not Redis.

**r02** — False premise: there is **no per-user API rate-limiting middleware**. The registered Connect interceptors are only Metadata, Logging, Recovery, and Auth (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-137`); no limiter/throttle exists anywhere in `server/`, `internal/`, or `cmd/` (no `golang.org/x/time/rate` dependency). There are therefore no request limits to report.

**r03** — False premise: there is **no nightly database-cleanup cron job**. A `internal/scheduler` cron package exists, but it is never imported by production code (only its own tests/examples). The one scheduled background job is the S3 presign runner, driven by a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (not cron), and it refreshes presigned URLs — it is not a DB cleanup. No scheduled cleanup time exists.

**r04** — False premise: there is **no message broker** — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (no such dependency in the repo). Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel, `asyncPostQueue` (`make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), consumed by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`webhook.go:42-55`). "Declared" at `webhook.go:39`; producers enqueue via `PostAsync` (`webhook.go:190`).

**r05** — False premise: there is **no GraphQL** anywhere in the codebase. The public API is **Connect/gRPC** (protobuf services under `server/router/api/v1/`, registered via `connectrpc.com/connect`) exposed as REST/JSON through the **grpc-gateway** (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`), with auxiliary Echo routes for the fileserver, RSS, and an OpenAPI-driven MCP surface. No GraphQL schema is defined.
